subject: info-intr
title: (R)INFO.INTR.------TRS.
description: Diagram in NYM-5. (R)INFO-INTR — the *reality* of information interpretation — is crossed with TRS (transition). The diagram poses what real interpretation requires when crossed with the transition the post-Ayler movement was undergoing: from a young, isolated school into the political-aesthetic position of the late sixties. INT (intention), AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), and PRI-INFO (primary information) all feed INFO-INTR. PRI-INFO also → TRS (the crossing). TRS → PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). POL-DYM (political dynamics) → SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars) ← PROG-SIGN. PROG-SIGN → MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). MTA-IMP (meta-implications) → PROG-SIGN. C-CONT (composite continuance) → MTA-IMP. Structural argument: real information interpretation is over-determined upstream by intention, affinity dynamics, and primary information together. Primary information also feeds transition directly — meaning the chain to transition can bypass the interpretation node when primary information is operative. Once at transition, progressional significance is the productive output, fed parallel by transition itself, by the political-dynamics → social-reality-particulars chain, by meta-implications, and reaching meta-reality significance as terminal. The diagram thus stages how the post-Ayler movement could *bypass* interpretive distortion if its primary information was strong enough to feed transition directly — exactly the structural opportunity Braxton sees the New York School as having seized.
